items.q: Is it free and open source?
items.a: Yes — free and open source under GPL-3.0. Source code on GitHub, no ads or telemetry, anyone can audit and contribute.

items.q: Do I need to install Java?
items.a: No, it auto-downloads the matching Java runtime. You can also manually specify an existing Java path in settings.

items.q: Is migration from other launchers hard?
items.a: Supports importing instances from HMCL, PCL2, and Prism Launcher — just select the directory for one-click migration, mods and configs preserved.
Identical features. Portable runs without install, configs stored alongside the executable, great for USB drives. Installer registers shortcuts and file associations, easier to update.
Link a GitHub private repo in settings, select instances and saves to sync, the launcher auto-pushes and pulls. No third-party servers involved.

items.q: What if I run into issues?
items.a: Read the docs first, ask in the community group, or file a report on GitHub Issues.
Switch to the Android tab on the download page and pick the right APK: arm64 for most phones & tablets, x86_64 for emulators. If prompted about "unknown sources", allow installation to proceed.

items.q: Are Android and desktop features the same?
items.a: Core features are identical: instance management, mod installation, skin center, multi-account login — all adapted for touch. Some desktop-only features (like large-scale seed map rendering) are adjusted for mobile and will be expanded in future updates.

items.q: Can my phone run Minecraft well?
items.a: Depends on your device. We recommend at least 6 GB RAM and a Snapdragon 8-series or equivalent. The launcher auto-tunes memory allocation; for modpacks, lower render distance and graphics for smoother gameplay.
